title: Haaye shaam ka baazaar
body:

Woh lakho tamasai be parda fufi behne

<<MINI>>
(Haai Shaam ka baazaar) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis tarah karaar aaye bimaar ko ay logon
Sar naizon pe pairon ke aate hai nazar jisko
Yeh juror musafir ki yeh kaisi sazaa hai
<<MINI>>
(Haai Shaam ka baazaar) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aakhon se hai khun zaari Khar hai bimaari

<<MINI>>
(Haai Shaam ka baazaar) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Zaagir nahi maangi zanjir nahi badli

(Haai Shaam ka baazaar) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda se masaaeb bhi har waqt rulaate hai

<<DIVIDER>>
Jinda se rihaa hoke bhi jinda me hain Sajjad

<<MINI>>
(Haai Shaam ka baazaar) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Be zakhm bhi sajjad ko jine nahi deta
Zakhmon se sakina ke jo chipkaa raha kurtaa
Woh Khun bharaa kurta hi kafan Us ko banaa hai
<<MINI>>
(Haai Shaam ka baazaar) x2

Baazaar me darbaar me jinda me roye
Chaalis baraz mawt ke armaan me roye
